title: Agency Yard Holding Charges for Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Recoveries
content:
An involuntary recovery under a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract carries one transport charge, for the recovery tow and the agency's holding of the vehicle until it reached the storage lot. The agency's holding of the vehicle before lot intake is charged by the nights it held the vehicle.

**Nights held.** The nights are counted as the calendar days from the repossession date to the lot-intake date, the repossession date not counted and the lot-intake date counted. The lot-intake date is the date of the most recent condition report on the contract and, where two condition reports share that date, the first one listed.

**Charge for the hold.**

| Nights held before lot intake | Holding charge |
|---|---|
| 1 night up to 7 nights (the yard cap) | the yard rate of $25.00 for each night |
| More than 7 nights | $25.00 for each of the first 7 nights plus the long-hold rate of $15.00 for each further night |
| Vehicle taken to the lot on the day of the repossession | no holding charge |
| Most recent condition report dated before the repossession date (no report yet taken for this recovery) | no holding charge |
| No condition report on record | no holding charge |

Because the first 7 nights are always billed at $25.00, the charge never falls as the hold grows.

### Worked figures (hypothetical holds)

| Nights | Holding charge |
|---|---|
| 1 | $25.00 |
| 7 | 7 times $25.00, that is $175.00 |
| 8 | $175.00 plus $15.00, that is $190.00 |
| 10 | $175.00 plus 3 times $15.00, that is $220.00 |

A vehicle repossessed on the 4th of a month whose most recent condition report is dated the 9th was held 5 nights and carries $125.00. The dates are illustrative.
